description: Diffraction-limited spots on a camera, where the width is unknown and hot pixels are not. A Laplacian-of-Gaussian scale space measures each spot's own sigma instead of assuming one, and min_area of 2 rejects the single-pixel defects a threshold cannot tell from a molecule. Set min_sigma and max_sigma from the optics: a diffraction-limited spot has sigma of about 0.21 * lambda / NA, in pixels.
name: spots
